Counsel for Applicant :- Awanish Kumar Upadhyay Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.
1. Heard Mr. Awanish Kumar Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Ankita Tripathi,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. The applicant, namely-Sudeep Yadav is seeking bail in Case Crime No.73/2024 under Sections 419/420/467/468/471/170 I.P.C. and Section 66(D) I.T. Act, Police Station-Malipur,
District-Ambedkarnagar.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case due to enmity and rivalry.
No such incident, as alleged by the prosecution, took place.

He further submits that the applicant is a student who went to Ayodhya alongwith his friends, where the police intercepted them and questioned them and subsequently, the police arrested five to six persons but only challaned two persons including the applicant, namely-Sudeep Yadav in a fake case.

He further submits that as per the FIR it was informed by the informant that someone having Mobile No.7415732681 called the informant on Mobile No.9651161193 on 30.03.2024 at about 11:50 AM and told him that his name is Atul Rawat and is speaking from the office of Superintendent of Police, Ambedkarnagar and asked him to pay Rs.5000/- as bribe so that warrant may be issued against the opposite parties in a case which was lodged by the informant on 29.03.2024 at Police Station-Malipur, District-Ambedkarnagar.
He further submits that the entire allegations leveled against the applicant are false and fabricated, the applicant has not concern at all with the alleged incident.
4. Learned Counsel for the applicant further submits that the applicant did not make any call to the informant nor the aforesaid mobile number is registered in his name.

He further submits that the police also did not recover anything from the possession of the applicant to link him with the alleged incident, he went to Ayodhya with his friends where the police arrested him in a false case.

He further submits that the voice of the caller was also not sent for any laboratory test, which falsifies the whole case and the police has arrested him only to show good work and to give gravity to the alleged incident., thus, he submits that it is a false case and has been lodged only with the intention to defame the image of the applicant and his family members in the society.

He further submits that the applicant is a bright student and his career is at stake due to this false implication, thus, he submits that the bail application of the applicant may be allowed and he may be enlarged on bail.
5. Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed forth before the Court.
The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been touched upon at length.

It has been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required and is also ready to accept all the conditions which the Court may deem fit to impose upon him.

It has also been pointed out that the accused is not having any criminal history and he is in jail since 05.04.2024 and that in the wake of heavy pendency of cases in the Court, there is no likelihood of any early conclusion of trial.
6. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail, however, he is unable to dispute the contentions raised by learned counsel for the applicant.

7. After perusing the record in the light of the submissions made at the bar and after taking an overall view of all the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence, the period of detention already undergone, the unlikelihood of early conclusion of trial and also in the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence and considering the fact that the applicant is a student and his entire career is at stake due to this false implication and there appears force in the argument of learned Counsel for the applicant that the applicant did not make any call to the informant nor the aforesaid mobile number is registered in his name and the police also did not recover anything from the possession of the applicant to link him with the alleged incident, he went to Ayodhya with his friends where the police arrested him in a false case.

8. The prayer for bail is granted.
The application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant, Sudeep Yadav be released on bail in the Case Crime No.73/2024 under Sections 419/420/467/468/471/170 I.P.C. and Section 66(D) I.T. Act, Police Station-Malipur,
District-Ambedkarnagar with the following conditions:-
(1) The applicant will not make any attempt to tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(2) The applicant will personally appear on each and every date fixed in the court below and his personal presence shall not be exempted unless the court itself deems it fit to do so in the interest of justice.
(3) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(4) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.

(5) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(6) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court default of this condition is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of his bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
10. It may be observed that in the event of any breach of the aforesaid conditions, the court below shall be at liberty to proceed for the cancellation of applicant's bail.
